The '''Ruac system''' was a part of the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before<ref name="AIR" /> some point in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> it was the site of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Ruac Outpost]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ruac [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square U-7.<ref name="TEA" />
